title: A first-person walk of the sun derives the structure of fusion

statements.text: Walking the sun from inside with operators alone, and no observer terms such as mass or energy, derives the products of stellar fusion and its mass-deficit ratio, up to one coupling parameter the sun cannot derive about itself.

sources.quote: first-person fold-accounting derives the complete structure of stellar fusion, including the projection-invariant mass-deficit ratio, modulo one self-opaque coupling parameter
